content:
Next year's iPhone Pro models are expected to adopt a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the iPhone's 20th anniversary. Today, a new leak has detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model.

Here's the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design.

It's only a few weeks until Apple releases its first foldable phone, the iPhone Ultra. But next year will bring another unique, brand-new iPhone design.

Rumors suggest Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. The new phone is reportedly set to feature a larger display with a four-sided curved screen, with glass extending to the edges of the device, creating a visually near-bezel-less effect.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital updated Apple's progress on achieving this unique look in a new post today.

He said Apple used the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but with adjustments, using a more rounded material.

The post also noted improvements in two areas:

  • Heat dissipation
  • Slimness

It remains difficult to determine Apple's target specifications for thickness and design materials. However, signs so far suggest this new phone will reference the design concepts of the iPhone Air and Ultra, but won't equally prioritize slimness.

Based on this latest news, it looks like we may see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra on a model that still delivers the performance and battery life Pro users expect.

Pro users don't want to sacrifice performance for slimness. But if Apple can deliver a similar experience on a slightly thinner model, along with a unique all-glass look, it would be quite appealing.

How interested are you in the rumored iPhone Pro 20 model next year? Let us know in the comments.
